frame_79.jpg.note: Tiny red specks in rigid block grids on flat sand, with no individual detail or ground contact. They read as game-strategy unit markers or RTS sprites.

frame_48.jpg.note: The figures are smooth, plasticky mannequins with stiff upright poses and soft, flat lighting. Their weak shadows make them look pasted onto the cobbles, in sharp contrast to the highly detailed, photoreal walls.

frame_25.jpg.note: Tiny identical peg-like figures stand evenly spaced along the parapet, with block-colored uniforms and a low-poly, Minecraft-like fort. They look like a diorama or tabletop wargame set.

frame_67.jpg.note: The frame is the same as frame_25: toy-soldier rows, cube crates and cannonball piles, and a flat, game-like environment. The figures stand in neat lines like a miniature set.

frame_96.jpg.note: The frame is the same as frame_79: tiny red blocks of units on a flat, untextured sand plane, like RTS game units seen from far away.

frame_49.jpg.note: Waxy, smooth, glossy figures in simplified coats, some with oversized heads, stand in stiff poses. Their grounding is weak and their shading doesn't match the gritty photoreal street. They look like painted figurines placed in a realistic set.
